description: This file defines the login page component and server-side actions for user authentication in a Remix framework React application. It handles user login form, server-side redirection if already logged in, and login submission logic.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Redirects to /app if a user is already authenticated.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Handles login form submission, authenticates user based on email/password, and creates a session.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React component rendering the login form UI, utilizing URL search parameters for redirect logic.
